create_concat_dataset: create a ConcatDataset instance that concatenates multiple OmniDataset instances with configurable batching strategy
build_concat_iterator: build a ConcatIterator from a ConcatDataset to iterate over concatenated datasets with epoch-based shuffling
configure_batching_strategy: configure the ConcatDataset batching strategy to use_one for individual or use_all for combined batches
set_repeat_factors: set repeat factors on ConcatDataset to control how many times each dataset is repeated during iteration
get_sample_from_iterator: get a sample from the ConcatIterator by calling get_sample to fetch merged data from active sources
